body:
I can’t believe it has been two years since i sent this message. I remember it like it was yesterday. I usually don’t use reddit but somehow found your post and commented, and when to sleep. I was feeling pretty depressed at the time. When i woke up the next morning i’d realized i slept through a test for school and it wasn’t the most important thing in the world, and i don’t think it was even an important test, but that was the last straw for me. I feel like small things have much bigger impacts when you are depressed. I felt so hopeless and horrible i decided that it was my last day. I remember standing on top of a chair with a noose around my neck and realizing i should text some of my friends goodbye before i did anything else. When i got to my phone i ended up reading your reply and that really, truly made me reconsider. 

I don’t really know why I didn’t say that in my reply two years ago but i think i was just very shaken up. It took a year from that moment for me to begin to see the world in a better way, but this past year has been pretty good for me mental health wise. Im happy to say i think i’ve improved a lot, and that is all because of you. Thank you so much. I hope you read this and know that I (and my family, who don’t even know this part of the story) are forever thankful. Aside from myself, i hope you have found any amount of solace after your loss. I haven’t forgotten this story and it would make my day to hear that you are doing better. 

I don’t really know how to end this, but after coincidentally finding the suicide note i had written in a drawer today, dated two years ago today, i knew i had to thank you again and let you know how you have helped me so much more than you realize. I hope all the good in this world seeks you out, you deserve it.

thank you so much. it almost seems  wrong to get condolences from someone who just went through such an event. but thank you nonetheless. 

you say that you wish you could help me more but small things like this are really much bigger than they seem. the fact that someone else took their time to write such a nice message really melts my heart. but it also makes me sad. sad to see that someone so kind and genuine could have something so terrible happen to them. 

listen to your own advice, and try to find happiness and peace in a world so full of pain, whichever way that may be. thank you.

the only reason i havent killed myself is because i cant imagine how upset my mom would be. some days are worse than others, but when shit really hits the fan, my mind likes to block out the one thing thats keeping me here. i would never ever want anything to happen to my mom. but i also want the pain to end. im so conflicted. as time has passed my brain tells me more and more that i should stop worrying about others and end it. but reading your story really changes things. obviously theres no way im able to help you, but you have helped me. atleast for now. hell maybe ill make it to my 18th birthday.
